2.99.9 ChartSeries.ChartSmartLabel
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartSeries.ChartSmartLabel element specifies the properties of a smart label. This element is
optional. This element is of type ChartSmartLabel.
Following is the parent element of the ChartSeries.ChartSmartLabel element.
Parent elements
ChartSeries
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartSeries.ChartSmartLabel element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartSmartLabel" type="ChartSmartLabelType" minOccurs="0" />
